newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk party to march in Ankara despite police ban.
newsitem.headline: Turk party to march in Ankara despite police ban.

text.p: A planned march by a left-wing political party in Ankara on Sunday to protest against a long-running security scandal has been banned by the provincial governor, Turkish daily Yeni Yuzyil said on Sunday.
"It has been conveyed (to the party) that this meeting is illegal," a statement by Ankara governor, Erdogan Sahinoglu was quoted as saying by Yeni Yuzyil.
Sources from the Freedom and Solidarity Party, who planned the demonstration, said on Sunday the march would go ahead despite the police warning.

The march is set to protest against alleged links between right-wing gangsters and top government officials. The allegations emerged last November after a mafia boss and a senior policeman died in a car crash together. A government MP was also in the car.
